speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Kidney Stone (Nephrolithiasis)

The patient is a 42-year-old male with visible hematuria, right flank pain, and no fever or recent trauma, which strongly suggests a kidney stone rather than an infection or malignancy. Given the history of recurrent UTIs, I will also need to rule out struvite stones or an underlying obstruction. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis with microscopy and urine culture.
